experiments.purpose: Exact rich-support collision diagnostic, weighted ternary root-count histograms versus selected binomial control; test whether marginal extraction conceals joint deficits. No asymptotic hardness inference.

parameters.comparison: uniform d-subsets versus one binomial support at d=2,4

experiments.precision: Exact uint64 weighted counts for n<=16; exact Python rational postprocessing; floating square roots only for displayed TV upper bounds. beta values are diagnostic posterior parameters, not claimed exact Gaussian tau.
experiments.tail_bound: No truncation or probabilistic tails: exhaustive finite ternary enumeration.
experiments.command: g++ -O3 -std=c++17 experiments/E01-root-collisions.cpp -o experiments/E01-root-collisions; execute with aggregate 120 second timeout
